'''Byun Tenab''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]]. A skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was filled with junk and rubbish.
